Chapter 6612: Death Via Tofu

Chapter 6612: Death Via Tofu

He thought about how his battle intent didn’t affect the youth. Something was amiss.

“Who are you?” He asked.

Li Qiye only focused on Time Stopper and didn’t answer him.

“Whoosh!” Grand Preceptor arrived and stared at Time Stopper.

“Young Friend, would you be willing to give me the treasure?” He had a transcending and ancient aura capable of swaying anyone.

Others would be presenting Time Stopper to him with both hands and tears streaming down their cheeks.

“Grand Preceptor, enough with the pretentious ploy.” Visceraless arrived at the same time as True Emperor Jiu Ning.

His momentum canceled out Grand Preceptor’s aura, causing the latter to scowl.

“Time Stopper?” Visceraless wanted to come closer but staggered backward upon seeing Li Qiye’s face.

“Young Noble.” Jiu Ning, on the other hand, bowed to show respect.

This astounded everyone else including Dugu Yuan who had just arrived. Other primal ancestors and heaven-slayers on the way couldn’t believe it.

“Who is he?” A few of them spoke among themselves.

Li Qiye finally looked up and noticed Visceraless’ gauntlet.

“You...” Visceraless stammered as if he were looking at a ghost, further confusing the crowd.

This man feared nothing due to his gauntlet. However, he appeared to be on the verge of running away in fear.

All eyes were on Li Qiye, scanning for his identity and background.

“You little crab, I don’t see any improvement, how embarrassing.” Li Qiye said.

This was no different than slapping Visceraless in public. Alas, Visceraless looked as if he were a student who didn’t do a great job and was being subjected to his teacher’s criticism.

He turned red and couldn’t respond, showing no sign of anger. After a long while, he gathered enough courage to speak: “I... I tried my best, that’s why I can use it...”

The guy was a demon crab who always raised his pincers against others including supreme overlords. Of course, the latter didn’t want to risk a fight for no reason due to his gauntlet.

“If you couldn’t use it by this point, you should smash your head against a block of tofu and commit suicide.” Li Qiye said in a matter-of-fact tone.

Visceraless had a forced smile as he said: “I cultivated for a long time, at least I can punch once.”

“How strong is it?” Li Qiye asked.

“Sixty, maybe seventy percent?” He turned red again and responded without confidence.

“At sixty percent, you can break an immortal. Can you?” Li Qiye said.

Listeners became emotional.

“I-is it that strong?” Someone stammered.

Others knew the gauntlet was a threat to overlords. However, they didn’t have a full gauge of its potential, believing it could injure an overlord at best.

However, would one hundred percent be enough to kill one? Now, this unknown guy spoke about how it can break an immortal at sixty percent already.

“Then what is my current mastery?” He had evaluated his progress with the gauntlet’s power.

“Just the bare surface.” Li Qiye didn’t hold back.

“Just the bare surface...” He turned red like a boiled crab. Was this due to embarrassment or excitement?

Others exchanged glances of astonishment. Some thought Li Qiye was embellishing.

If the bare surface could threaten overlords, then what about ten percent mastery? Its true power would be beyond imagination.
